meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能管理 NanoClaw 代理容器可访问的主机目录白名单：查看允许的目录及读写权限，添加或移除目录，并写入配置文件。新配置会对新容器自动生效。
howto.when: 当用户提到“mounts”、“mount allowlist”等关键词，或要求查看、添加、移除容器能访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 查看当前允许挂载的目录
say.note: Claude 会读取并展示白名单及读写状态

say.text: 把 /project 加进允许列表，只读
say.note: 会验证路径并询问读写权限后写入配置

say.text: 移除 /tmp 目录的访问权限
say.note: 会更新配置文件，移除该目录

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can manage the host-directory allowlist for NanoClaw agent containers: view allowed directories with read-only/read-write flags, add or remove entries, and write the config file. New mounts apply automatically to newly spawned containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'mounts', 'mount allowlist', etc., or asks to view/add/remove directories that agent containers can access.

say_en.text: Show the current allowed mount directories.
say_en.note: Claude reads and displays the allowlist with access modes.

say_en.text: Add /project to the allowlist as read-only.
say_en.note: Validates the path and asks about write access before saving.
Updates the config to drop that entry.
